This '''pilot''' was present on [[Birgis]] in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]]. A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]], she was tasked by [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] to ferry information to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] as the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Battle of Birgis|attacked]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].
